policy: Grass is allowed throughout the battle field and character positions. Most grass targets 40-60 percent of the actual 3m review proxy (1.2-1.8m), lower near actors and taller in broad border clusters. The previous 0.35m short-cover cap is superseded. Clover is understory; flowers are accents. Actual highest terrain/mesh surface controls placement, with a 0.08m maximum root gap. Head visibility uses 2.5m targets, not a 1.6m torso prohibition.
measurement: Height statistics use transformed actual LOD0 vertex positions, excluding stored animation bounds. Root tests sample actual root vertices against highest scene geometry. Values are starting art choices, not a player performance guarantee.
